Engineering Real-World Solutions
We do more than educate students — we empower visionaries and pioneers to shape the future of engineering and computer science.
Apply Now
The College of Engineering and Computer Science at University of Michigan-Dearborn offers bachelor's, master’s and doctoral degree programs as well as undergraduate and graduate certificate programs. Our programs are taught by renowned faculty experts who lead classroom discussion and work with industry partners geared toward solving the challenges of the ever-changing global economy.

A Welcome Message from Interim Dean Zakarian
Welcome to the College of Engineering and Computer Science, where we dedicate ourselves to empowering students, creating opportunities, and fostering groundbreaking innovations. Whether you are a prospective or current student, a visitor, a community member, or an alumnus, I warmly welcome you!
Our Partnership with KEEN
The University of Michigan–Dearborn is a proud partner of the Kern Entrepreneurial Engineering Network (KEEN). Through hands-on projects and real-world challenges, students build both technical expertise and professional skills. Guided by KEEN’s principles of curiosity, connections, and creating value, our graduates are ready to innovate, lead, and make a meaningful impact in a rapidly evolving world.
Rankings & Recognitions
U.S. News & World Report ranked UM-Dearborn #1 Regional Public University in Michigan.
U.S. News & World Report ranked UM-Dearborn one of the Best Regional Public Universities in the Midwest.
U.S. News & World Report ranked the undergraduate engineering programs (doctorate) and the Computer Science undergraduate degree program rank fifth among public universities in Michigan.
